artwork.paintingLabel: At the Mirror by Lovis Corinth

prompt: Paint a vertically composed German Impressionist interior scene dated 1912, adapted to a square canvas without changing the arrangement. In the lower foreground, a dark-haired woman sits with her back toward us at a dressing table, both elbows raised as she adjusts her black hair. Her white embroidered blouse, dark green-gray skirt and black coiffure are broadly painted. Directly behind her, a tall mirror reflects her pale face and upper body, white blouse, green skirt and uplifted arms. A mustached man in a cream jacket appears standing at the far upper left. Include a cluttered dark interior with ornate furniture, gray reflections, flowers at upper right. Loose vigorous oily strokes, muted charcoal, cream, sage and brown, weathered varnish, visible canvas.
